scope: Actual generated Prisma/PostgreSQL, Express document router, real JWTs and actual Windows filesystem; synthetic cases/files only. No remote provider/signature/filing/payment/production proof.
checks: Actual document router rejects anonymous access
Unassigned staff, foreign client and another company cannot upload or create metadata
HR, read-only compliance and team-lead identity-document restrictions enforced
Real multipart upload writes confined filesystem bytes and durable hash/operation metadata
Assigned staff, owner client, own-company admin, compliance and global founder download actual original bytes
Download matrix denies unrelated users, another tenant and lead access to identity originals
Client lists filter internal document types and omit storage paths and internal financial fields
Per-case list and view endpoints cannot bypass case ownership
Unrelated users cannot sign; even the owner cannot fabricate signature completion from a URL
Manual review remains own-company admin authority while deletion stays founder-only
Registered byte corruption is rejected; no unregistered fallback masks a failed hash
Legacy traversal record cannot read outside the confined adapter root
Actual audit failure blocks byte release and leaves uploaded target identifiable for reconciliation
Explicit authorized reconciliation verifies saved bytes and finishes a previously uncertain upload
Actual filesystem hard-link refusal preserves failed replica and primary registry plus document for retry
Explicit retry deletes actual replica and primary bytes, reconciles registries and preserves deletion audit
Case reassignment immediately revokes the previous employee document access
Domain and HTTP checks revalidate tenant and disabled-account authority
Assigned team lead retains permitted internal document access while case detail hides identity documents
Actual client case list excludes internal financial fields and internal document types
Actual client case detail cannot expose storage paths, credentials or founder fields
Actual case read and update reject another company administrator
Case search retains the authorized tenant and assignment filter
Case patch rejects nested ownership and tenant injection
Global financial statistics require global founder authority
Expired existing portal policy is enforced on public token readback
